resources.string: I’m your tutorial guide. To learn a feature, go to its screen and tap me. I’ll guide you through it.
I’m still learning this screen. You can practice these features now:
Hi! How can I help you?
Hi, %1$s! How can I help you?
Tell us what you need help with. Our team will reply here.
Your query has been sent. You can read the reply here when it arrives.
Could not load your queries. Tap Refresh to try again.
Could not send your query. Your text is still here; please try again.
Sign in to send a query and read your replies.
Tap Add to create a habit. Give it a name and choose the days you want to follow it.
In Today, mark a habit done after you finish it. Use Weekly or Monthly to see your progress.
Open a habit to change its schedule or reminder. Use Insights to review your consistency.
Read the setup explanation and allow the required accessibility permission. The permission guide will show you how.
Add the YouTube channels you want to study with and choose which channels are allowed.
Finish setup and turn on YouTube Focus. You can return to this screen to change your channels or turn it off.
